name: Costco Wet Depot #265, Monroe Township NJ

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Roster coords land on the SE face of the large light-gray-roof building at 12 Costco Dr; reefer condenser bank on that south wall confirms it is the WET/refrigerated depot, distinct from the larger solar-roofed dry depot (#175, 10 Costco Dr) to the north. Audited the wet building/yard only.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Costco runs a guarded, appointment-only truck check-in (driver reviews cite the best check-in/out on the East Coast). A small ~1-vehicle white booth sits beside the east perimeter truck road at ~40.35708,-74.46199 with a striped/hatched pavement table and crosswalk at the truck pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth at the east truck-road pinch (z20 imagery); footprint and position consistent with a guard/check-in shack. Medium confidence on staffing vs unmanned kiosk from overhead alone.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank runs the full ~340 m south face with dense, regular leveler rhythm and trailers backed in (z20). Easily 50+; point estimate ~85.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-drop rows along the SW apron hold orange/white/dark trailers without tractors (z19 SW); a dedicated drop block, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck road and apron around the south/east with unused width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park beside the NJ Turnpike with a golf course and woods immediately south; broader setting reads Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.streetView: Public Street View covers only the internal car road (Costco Dr, north entrance) and the east blank-wall road. The north entrance pano (OQa6dk03-14O3aB-N4SE2Q, 2025-06) shows the building + monument sign and is used for perimeter. No pano confirms the truck gate/booth, so truckGate streetView hasCoverage=false.
